label: Pipeline Flow (animated step rail)
description: A compact motion-graphic chip that plays a process as motion: 2-5 labelled nodes on a rail, a glowing pulse travelling between them, each node lighting as the pulse arrives and the rail filling behind it. Built to ride OVER footage -- it carries its own dark blurred card, so it stays legible on a ground whose brightness the author does not control. Time it to the words: give `at` the second the speaker starts describing the process and `step` the beat between stages, and the graphic reads as authored to the script rather than decoration.

nodes.label: Nodes
nodes.description: 2-5 entries of { label, icon }. icon is one of: mail, spark, video, chart, check, doc, bolt, cloud.

hold.label: Seconds the completed rail holds before it exits (default 1.2)

exit.label: Fade the card out after the hold (default true; false leaves it standing)
